articles.title: Trump says every adult American would get $5,000 if Republicans win midterm elections
articles.description: Speaking at a party convention, the US president gave no details on how the plan would work or where the money would come from.

articles.title: Watch: Is Trump's $5,000 election pledge legal?
articles.description: The US president has said every American will get $5,000 (£3,700) if the Republican Party wins November's midterms.

articles.title: England's mayors to be given power to introduce tourist tax
articles.description: The government is expected to detail how local leaders will be able to impose levies on overnight stays.

articles.title: RNLI reviews security after volunteers targeted online
articles.description: Volunteers were targeted online after it assisted in the rescue of people crossing the Channel on Sunday.
